questions.prompt: When does OpenAI's guide say to create a project?

options.text: When work continues over time and depends on the same files
options.explanation: Right. For self-contained work, the ChatGPT docs say to start a chat without a project.

options.text: For every chat, so that no chat is ever left outside a project
options.explanation: The ChatGPT docs say to start a chat without a project when the work is self-contained.

options.text: Only when a developer has set up an API key for the team
options.explanation: Projects are part of the chat app. No API key is needed.

questions.prompt: What is a desk agent best used for?

options.text: A one-line question that needs a quick answer
options.explanation: That is a chat. A desk agent uses more of your plan for a job that needs many steps.

options.text: A multi-step task that ends in a file you review
options.explanation: Right. ChatGPT Work and Claude Cowork take an outcome and hand back a result to check.

options.text: Software that must call the model with no person
options.explanation: That is an API job for a developer, on its own bill.

questions.prompt: What do Anthropic and OpenAI say about API costs and chat plans?

options.text: The API is billed apart from the chat plans
options.explanation: Right. Anthropic: the Claude API is billed separately. OpenAI: API token prices are separate from subscription usage.

options.text: Every chat seat includes unlimited API use
options.explanation: Neither page says that. Both keep API billing apart from the chat plans. Some plans add a monthly API credit, but not unlimited use.

options.text: API prices tell you how many chats you get
options.explanation: The ChatGPT docs say not to use API token prices to estimate included tasks.
